spans.s:
द्वैगुण्य n. the double, double the amount, value,
measure, etc.
द्वैजात a. belonging to or consisting of the twice-born.
द्वैतवाद m. the doctrine of dualism.

द्वैधीभाव m. duality, double state or nature;
duplicity, fraud, uncertainty, doubt.

द्वैधीभू go asunder into two parts, become
separated or disunited.
1 द्वैप a. being in or coming from an island.
2 द्वैप a. coming from a tiger or panther.
द्वैपायन m. the island-born, E. of Vyāsa.
द्वैप्य a. living in or coming from an island.

द्वैमातुर a. having two mothers (a natural m. and a
stepmother).

द्वैराज्य^1 a. dominion divided between two princes.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: missing 'E' Devanagari vowel.
द्वैविध्य n. duality, twofold nature or manner.
